integrity: Exact deterministic, standalone Python 3 enumeration and full-Hasse acyclicity test were executed; its source and complete output are included. There has been no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact calculation restricted to even longitudinal lengths 2, 4, 6, 8 and the two stated graph families. No recurrence or assertion for longer lengths; the checker must be run for independent computational reproduction.
title: A boundary-sensitive eight-column classification of three-row perfect-matching complexes
